news.title: 10-year Treasury yield rockets to 19-year high. Here's what's driving the spike
news.description: Treasury yields traded higher on Wednesday as new services and manufacturing sector data increased worry of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.

news.title: New Social Security bill would lower retirement age to 60 for some workers
news.description: Rep. Haley Stevens introduced a bill that would let some workers in physically demanding jobs claim full Social Security retirement benefits at age 60.

news.title: As Trump and Xi meet, Chinese automakers could be a Pandora's box for U.S. auto industry
news.description: Trump’s meeting with Xi comes as U.S. automakers and lawmakers push to keep restrictions on Chinese vehicles and manufacturers.
